environment.description: Same Quarkus container deployed in Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at namespace level via label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted'. The restricted profile mandates: runAsNonRoot, drop ALL capabilities, seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault, no hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC, no hostPath volumes, no privileged containers. Additionally, a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy with spec.egress rules limits pod egress to only endpoints matching label 'app.kubernetes.io/part-of=webhook-targets' on ports 443/tcp, and a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy denies all egress to CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 and 10.0.0.0/8 except the explicitly allowed webhook-targets pods. DNS egress is permitted only to kube-dns on port 53/udp.
